name: Hedron cocoon
description: A protective sheath of interlocked stone hedrons around Ugin, bound by a single shard that Sorin destroys.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is pulled back through time and finds himself before the weathered hedron cocoon, evidence that many years have passed.
timeline.quote: He was standing before the hedron cocoon, exactly where he had been a mere moment before

timeline.summary: Sorin sees the hedron cocoon in a chasm and wonders if Nahiri was there.
timeline.quote: Lithomancy on Tarkir? Had Nahiri traveled here before him and bested the dragon?

timeline.summary: Sorin drains the thrall of what blood remains and uses blood magic to destroy the hedron shard and unmake the cocoon, freeing Ugin.
timeline.quote: The hedron shard crumbled to dust, and the cocoon began to crack.

pages_say.description: The ice-covered stone cocoon of hedrons protecting the fallen Ugin.
A protective sheath of interlocked stone hedrons around Ugin, bound by a single shard that Sorin destroys.
